caption:
Global Metadata: A lively, joyful Celtic jig, 128 BPM, bright D major. Driven by a spirited fiddle (violin) playing a fast ornamented melody, joined by a tin whistle (small fipple flute), a piano accordion, a bodhrán (Irish frame drum) and a simple bass line. It opens with the fiddle and whistle playing a bouncy jig tune together, the accordion and bodhrán add the rhythm, the fiddle takes a flying solo, then the full band plays a final spirited chorus and ends on a crisp cheerful chord. Production profile: warm, close pub-style folk recording, lively and crisp, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: No vocals at all. Purely instrumental. Do not add any singing, humming, or voice.

Arrangement: Intro, the fiddle plays a bouncy jig phrase, the tin whistle joins. Section one, the accordion and bodhrán add the rhythm, the fiddle and whistle play the tune together. Section two, the fiddle takes a flying ornamented solo over the band. Section three, the full band plays a final spirited chorus. Outro, a crisp cheerful ending chord.
